BL-738 — BL-718's chunking property test caps generated strings at 200 chars — never exercises the real 4096-char split boundary
What it solves: BL-723 architect verdict on BL-718: not-on-par (independent finding,
additional to the coder's already-filed acceptance-wiring gap: BL-726/727).
Linked pilot-process defect: BL-739.
Approval context: One open decision, with a recommendation. The ticket offers two fixes: generate longer strings against the real 4096 default, or pass a small maxLen so ordinary lengths split. Recommendation is the second - it keeps the property fast and, more importantly, removes the second number entirely, so not…
BL-738 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-738" (or "reject BL-738 <reason>") to act.
